entries.judgment: Whole helper read; common native mechanics preserve Git wrapper argv/status/raw-byte/deadline contract. Optional Python version caller owns five-second degraded metadata policy. Stream draining is concurrent; per-call process, buffers and cancellation disposed. No shell or new package. Actual heldout process tests verify direct child only; full raw buffers are not byte-capped and no descendant guarantee after parent exit is claimed.

Whole helper read and both prior Resolve-EvidenceKey implementations compared. Shared priority env > explicit file > home and byte normalization are technical signing-key acquisition, while critical-risk admission and HMAC remain callers. ASCII-tail/BOM handling fixes prior LINQ failure. Environment bytes remain exact; file interior binary bytes retained; ref contains source path but no key bytes. Explicit unreadable file still returns null rather than silently changing source.

Whole helper read and producer/consumer containment boundaries inspected. Canonical existing filesystem resolution only: caller retains containment, regular-file and reparse policy. ReparsePoint excludes hardlinks. .NET API path and bounded legacy Target fallback resolve relative components; fallback strips Windows device prefixes. Missing-method simulation covers relative two-hop directory links, not native Windows junction execution. Existing PS5.1+ public support requires native validation separately.

scope_limits: Independent heldout component tests, not fixture-copy of owner public generator/validator tests.
No native Windows PowerShell 5.1, installed distribution, live remote provider or full product guarantee from these controls.

NativeRaw retains full output bytes and direct-child cleanup scope; it does not claim bounded total allocation or guaranteed descendants cleanup after parent exit.

Public PowerShell5.1+ support disallows unguarded ResolveLinkTarget: owner added capability fallback; Linux simulated missing capability passes, native Windows remains CI responsibility.
